title: Serious Runway Incursions More Than Doubled
hook: The worst close calls are climbing and clustering at a few airports.
closing: Every runway incursion risks passengers before their flight even leaves the ground.
question: Does this change how you fly?

segments.say: Serious runway incursions rose to 23. The most dangerous close calls more than doubled over roughly a decade.
60 percent of runway incursions came from pedestrians or vehicles. The threat is not always another aircraft.
A small airport cluster accounts for 33 percent of the worst incursions. Risk is concentrated, not evenly spread.
